title: E02 radialbar
scenario: Outside-in rings, 25 percent slot gap, value/max sweep and noninteractive full tracks. Same 640×480 canvas, 48/32/28/36 margins and source values. Canvas lacks text/legend labels. Moxi retains Cartesian axes/grid even for radial marks; upstream uses its own radial/category presentation. Palette differences, arc tessellation and antialiasing remain. No physical input, native, VoiceOver or human-performance claim.
backend: Mojo Scene/Canvas offscreen; pinned dataviz; local headless Chrome evidence replay
